name: Nephroid
description: The nephroid — the two-cusped kidney a circle traces rolling around another twice its size.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 240; x: 3 * cos(t) - cos(3t); y: 3 * sin(t) - sin(3t); scale: 0.25); clip-path: @shape(points: 240; x: 3 * cos(t) - cos(3t); y: 3 * sin(t) - sin(3t); scale: 0.25); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
